title: Reconcile pending intake and add signal integration tests
description: Background reconciler on process start: load pending intake ledger rows, re-dispatch with same dedupe keys, update delivery metadata, surface failures. Tests for duplicate HTTP retry, crash between steps 4-5, and rule that notification redelivery does not re-run workers.
why: Crash between ledger insert and Mastra dispatch must retry idempotently without duplicating worker side effects.

acceptance.text: Startup reconciler retries accepted-but-not-delivered rows with backoff
tests cover restart gap and notification dedupe
